review_output: {"summary":"I found no BLOCKER or MAJOR auth issues in the code you supplied. The close flow behaves as you described: it still requires current admission, the same verified identity and scope, and an enabled, unexpired version. Only the resolver's typed not_authorized error counts as unavailable content; other errors propagate. Retries keep their stored terminal state and can't turn false into true. The 200/202 statuses match appendOpen. One MINOR integrity gap: the append path doesn't enforce a pending close's sealed finalSequence. I can't see the database guard source, so a trigger may already block this.","findings":[{"severity":"MINOR","area":"Append/close sequence integrity","file":"src/lib/live-metric-ingestion.ts","issue":"Append never checks the pending finalSequence. A viewer can append beyond the sealed final sequence, so lastSequence > finalSequence and every later close returns 409. The session can never reach terminal closedAt.","evidence":"planMetricIntervalWrites only rejects when closedAt or complete is set. LockedMetricSession.finalSequence is loaded but unused. planMetricClose throws sequence_conflict when finalSequence < lastSequence before setting closedAt.","impact":"Breaks the 'pending close permits only missing earlier sequences' contract. Sessions stay non-terminal with appendOpen semantics broken; reports can't distinguish them from in-progress sessions.","recommended_fix":"Pass finalSequence into planMetricIntervalWrites. When finalSequence !== null, reject any new row with sequence > finalSequence as sequence_conflict, keeping exact replays allowed. Ideally also add a DB constraint or trigger.","required_test":"Real DB: start a pending close with finalSequence=N while lastSequence<N, append N+1 → 409 with no row inserted. Appending the missing sequence up to N succeeds, and close then returns 200 deliveryComplete=true.","confidence":0.6}]}
